title: Memento

act2.summary: a field added to the saved state, with zero edits to the caretaker

solutions.title: ExposureSetup hands out opaque mementos; the history never reads a field
solutions.tradeoff: The caretaker cannot leak what it cannot see - it literally cannot compile code that reads a field off a memento. The price: every field the setup wants remembered has to be threaded through createMemento and restore by hand; the memento does not update itself.

reviewFocus: Does SetupHistory reference any of ExposureSetup's field names anywhere, or only ExposureMemento as an opaque type?
Is ConcreteExposureMemento's constructor the only place a memento's fields are set, and setup.ts the only file that imports it by name?
Does adding ditherPattern touch history.ts at all, on the pattern route?
Is the `as ConcreteExposureMemento` cast in restore() actually safe, and does the walkthrough say why (only ExposureSetup ever constructs one)?
Would a WeakMap-backed opaque token (real runtime privacy, not just a type-level cast) have been worth the extra complexity here - and if not here, when?
